data.one_liner: A fast backend framework for Dart with routing, ORM, migrations, and middleware.
data.what_it_does: Vania runs an HTTP server, handles routing and middleware pipelines, and connects to an ORM, migrations, and validation system. It allows developers to build APIs and backend applications in Dart using a driver-agnostic database architecture.
use_when: You want to build a backend or API server in Dart.
You need an expressive framework with routing, ORM, and migrations out of the box.
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter app that only consumes APIs.
You require a built-in database driver inside the core package rather than a separate driver.
strengths: Batteries-included backend toolkit including routing, ORM, validation, and sessions.
Driver-agnostic database layer allows easy switching between MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
weaknesses: Requires separate companion driver packages to interact with specific databases.
Ecosystem is smaller compared to Node.js or Go backend alternatives.
data.setup_notes: Install vania_cli, run 'vania create project_name', and set up a database driver package.

alternatives.name: shelf
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose shelf if you want a lightweight, highly modular web server composition library rather than a full batteries-included framework.
